description: This source file defines the async API for TorchScript, including functions `fork` and `wait`, which facilitate parallel task execution within TorchScript. It includes function definitions, imports, and internal TorchScript registration calls.

classes.name: Future
classes.description: A class representing a future result for an asynchronous operation in TorchScript.

methods.name: fork(func, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task executing a given function or module, returning a Future object.

methods.name: wait(future)
methods.description: Blocks until the provided Future completes and returns its result.
